definitions.explanation: The subtle meaning or significance that goes beyond the literal meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧的な{意味合|いみあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01445_seiji⟧的な{意味合|いみあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{意味合|いみあ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00488_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand the implications of that.

notes:
{意味合|いみあ}い refers to the deeper significance or subtle meaning.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜的な{意味合|いみあ}いがある: has ~ implications
- {意味合|いみあ}いが{強|つよ}い: has strong implications/connotations
- {意味合|いみあ}いを{持|も}つ: to have implications

CONTRAST:
- {意味|いみ}: meaning (direct, literal)
- {意味合|いみあ}い: implication, nuance (indirect, subtle)
